question: How do I add custom branding like logos and colors to my Fern documentation?
ground_truth: You can configure custom branding for your Fern documentation by modifying the docs.yml file. You can set logos (dark and light versions), colors (with accent-primary for dark and light modes), fonts, and favicon. For example, add a colors section with accent-primary dark and light values, a logo section with paths to dark and light SVG files plus height and href properties, and a favicon path to customize your documentation's appearance.

metadata.cited_context:
All of the branding for your docs can be configured in the `docs.yml` file. For example, to set the logos, colors, and fonts for your docs, you can add the following to your `docs.yml` file:

```yml
colors:
  accent-primary:
    dark: "#f0c193"
    light: "#af5f1b"

logo:
  dark: docs/assets/logo-dark.svg
  light: docs/assets/logo-light.svg
  height: 40
  href: https://buildwithfern.com/

favicon: docs/assets/favicon.svg
```
